reason: The slides make sense, and Booking.com's commission does sting. But I have never met these people and they have never stayed on my island. My guests book because they trust my face on Instagram and my WhatsApp, and handing my booking page to a studio far away feels like giving a stranger my front door.
objection: A remote studio does not know my island or my guests, and when the booking page breaks on a Sunday night, I am the one who answers the angry WhatsApp messages.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a finished booking page from a guesthouse on my own coast, with the owner willing to tell me how it went and how many no-shows it stopped.
